notes.title: Hookah Haze Artbook Now Available & 20% OFF Sale on the Main Game!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773906/1768547e8f5f693f783ac185c8fcc4121e9627a8.jpg
Digital Artbook packed with the Charm of Hookah Haze Now Available!

In addition to in-game art assets such as character pixel art and background illustrations, this 150-page artbook is filled with SD characters used in merchandise, setting illustrations not seen in the main game, creator comments, and much more. To celebrate the release, it is being sold at a 10% discount, so be sure to take advantage of this opportunity!

notes.title: 1.0.3 Update Notice
notes.content:
When the following recipe was posted as a recommendation,
Fixed a bug that the heroine who came to the restaurant and the heroine who replied to the following day's recommendation posting were different.

-Rich Vanilla
-Extra Nut Coconut
-Viennese Coffee
-Matcha Cappuccino

The heroine who replies to a recommendation post is basically the heroine who visited the store,
If you cannot remember which heroine came to the store in which flavor, please look back at the replies to your recommendation postings.

Thank you for your continued support of "Hookah Haze".

notes.title: Trial Version Update Notice
notes.content:
The following bugs were fixed and functions were added in the trial version.

Bug Fixes
-When a gamepad is connected, the mouse pointer is forced to the center of the screen.
-Other minor adjustments

Added functions
-Footer and guide UI hide function

If you have any questions or requests, please contact us from the official inquiry form below.

https://hookah-haze.com/contact/index.html

Thank you for your continued support of Hookah Haze.
